mapper.select: SELECT * FROM ( SELECT category_id, category_name, parent_id, LEVEL AS lvl FROM category START WITH category_id = #{value} CONNECT BY PRIOR parent_id = category_id ) order by lvl desc
select category_id from category where category_name=#{value}

SELECT * FROM ( SELECT rownum rn, p.product_id, p.product_name, p.price, p.unit, p.status, p.category_id, c.category_path AS category FROM product p JOIN ( SELECT category_id, LTRIM(SYS_CONNECT_BY_PATH(category_name, '>'), '>') AS category_path FROM category START WITH parent_id IS NULL CONNECT BY PRIOR category_id = parent_id ) c ON p.category_id = c.category_id WHERE p.product_name LIKE '%' || #{value} || '%' OR c.category_path LIKE '%' || #{value} || '%' )
WHERE rn >= #{startRow} and rn <= #{endRow}

SELECT count(*) from product p JOIN ( SELECT category_id, LTRIM(SYS_CONNECT_BY_PATH(category_name, '>'), '>') AS category_path FROM category START WITH parent_id IS NULL CONNECT BY PRIOR category_id = parent_id ) c ON p.category_id = c.category_id WHERE p.product_name LIKE '%' || #{value} || '%' OR c.category_path LIKE '%' || #{value} || '%'
mapper.insert: insert into product( product_id, product_name, category_id, price, unit, image_id, status ) values( product_seq.nextval, #{product_name}, #{category_id}, #{price}, #{unit}, #{image_id}, #{status} )
